Write release notes for the changes since the Git ref named at the end (a tag, branch or commit). If no ref is named, use the latest tag (git describe --tags --abbrev=0), or the last 30 commits if there is no tag.

Use git log and git diff, and do not modify anything. Reply in Markdown with the sections Added, Changed, Fixed and Removed (leave out empty ones), one line per change that users or developers would notice, and a last line with the range you used (for example v1.2.0..HEAD).
